title: Adeptus Mechanicus Rules
subtitle: Complete local reference for Faction Pack v1.0, including Warhammer Legends

options.label: Protector
options.subtitle: Ballistic protocol
effects: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [HEAVY] ability.
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Each time a melee attack targets this unit, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

options.label: Conqueror
options.subtitle: Assault protocol
effects: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

detachments.title: Cohort Acquisitus
detachments.tagline: Adapted Skitarii hunters identify and eliminate targets in the Quest for Knowledge.

rule.title: Noospheric Recon
rule.text: Friendly PTERAXII, INFILTRATORS, RANGERS, SERBERYS RAIDERS and SERBERYS SULPHURHOUNDS units have RECON AUGURY. Friendly RECON AUGURY units have Enhanced Augurs: in your Shooting phase, this unit can select one visible enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is analysed. While a unit is analysed, that unit has +3" detection range.

enhancements.title: Explorator Dispensation
enhancements.text: SKITARII MARSHAL model only. This unit has Infiltrators.

enhancements.title: Stealth-screened Cybercanids Upgrade
enhancements.text: SERBERYS RAIDERS unit only. This unit has Lone Operative 15".

stratagems.title: Defect Scrutiny
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly RECON AUGURY unit. Your unit's ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.title: Repolarised Augurs
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged RECON AUGURY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has -3" detection range until the end of the turn.

stratagems.title: Clandestine Reposition
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged INFILTRATORS or PTERAXII unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in Strategic Reserves.

detachments.title: Lords of the Forge
detachments.tagline: Senior cyber-clergy and technohierarchs marshal the Machine God's devout.

rule.title: War-form Mantles
rule.text: Friendly TECH-PRIEST models have a 4+ invulnerable save and Feel No Pain 5+. They also have Baffling Data Screed: in your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot and is not Battle-shocked, roll one D6. On a 2+, select one enemy VEHICLE unit within 12"; it makes a Battle-shock test with -1. A unit cannot be selected more than once per turn. Alternatively, on a 2+, those ranged attacks do not prevent this unit from being hidden.

enhancements.title: Vingh's Wafers of Dynamism
enhancements.text: CYBERNETICA DATASMITH model only. At the start of the first battle round, if this unit is an Attached unit, this unit has MOBILE until the end of the battle.

enhancements.title: TL-4Ø9
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. The bearer gains TL-4Ø9: Range 24", A 3, BS 2+, S 11, AP -2, D D3+2, [DEVASTATING WOUNDS, HAZARDOUS].

stratagems.title: Scriptural Prognosis
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit that is within range of an objective.
stratagems.target: That TECH-PRIEST unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.title: Overloaded Safeguards
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That TECH-PRIEST unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot or declare a charge.

stratagems.title: Holy Avarice
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit starts an Action.
stratagems.target: That TECH-PRIEST unit.
stratagems.effect: That Action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

detachments.title: Luminen Auto-choir
detachments.tagline: Electro-Priests harness the Motive Force with ecstatic empowering chants. Unique: Data-Psalm.

rule.title: Cyber-static Canticles
rule.text: Friendly CORPUSCARII units' ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS]. When a friendly FULGURITE unit has fought, that unit heals D3 wounds. This Detachment has the DATA-PSALM tag and cannot be taken with another DATA-PSALM Detachment.

enhancements.title: Voltagheist Reliquary
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with Snap Shooting attacks.

enhancements.title: Electromiasmic Brazier
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. This unit has Stealth.

stratagems.title: Echoes of the Conduit Wars
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks that target a unit within range of an objective can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.title: Chant of Electrotraction
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ELECTRO-PRIESTS BATTLECLADE unit is selected to make an Advance move.
stratagems.target: That ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.title: Momentum Feedback
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Surge move of up to D6".

detachments.title: Eradication Cohort
detachments.tagline: Purely offensive Skitarii formations driven by the Omnissiah's murderous imperative.

rule.title: Murderous Imperative
rule.text: Each time a model in a SKITARII unit from your army makes an attack: if the Protector Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1; if the Conqueror Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.title: Omnicogitator
enhancements.text: SKITARII MARSHAL model only. The Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are both active for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.title: Martial Signatum Amplificator
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the SKITARII keyword.

enhancements.title: Belicosa-class Capacitor Vanes
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. Add 6" to the Range characteristic and 1 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.title: Omnissiah's Fury
enhancements.text: SKITARII MARSHAL model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of those weapons by 1.

stratagems.title: Servo-driven Charge
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LANCE].

stratagems.title: Threat-cogitation Targeters
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model, you can re-roll the Damage roll.

stratagems.title: Unrelenting Aggression
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot after Falling Back. If it has the SKITARII keyword, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge instead.

stratagems.title: Precision Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a SICARIAN unit from your army declares a charge.
stratagems.target: That SICARIAN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, after your unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range and roll one D6 for each model in your unit within Engagement Range of it; each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.title: Unshackled Wrath
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead select [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LETHAL HITS] and [HAZARDOUS] to apply together.

stratagems.title: Analytic Reprisals
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII INFANTRY unit from your army that lost one or more models to those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit and only if it is an eligible target.

detachments.title: Haloscreed Battle Clade
detachments.tagline: Tech-Priests project fragments of their consciousness through the noosphere to override their thralls.

rule.title: Noospheric Transference
rule.text: In your Command phase, select one or more ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units, including embarked units: 1 at Incursion, 2 at Strike Force, or 3 at Onslaught. Until your next Command phase, they gain HALO OVERRIDE. Select one Override ability: Electromotive Energisation (+2" Move), Microactuator Bracing (+1 Toughness), Predation Protocols (eligible to charge after Advancing), or Muted Servomotors (Stealth).

enhancements.title: Transoracular Dyad Wafers
enhancements.text: CYBERNETICA DATASMITH model only. When attached to KASTELAN ROBOTS, models in that unit gain HALO OVERRIDE until the end of the battle. That unit cannot be selected for Noospheric Transference.

enhancements.title: Cognitive Reinforcement
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only, excluding CYBERNETICA DATASMITH. The Conqueror and Protector Imperatives are both active for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.title: Sanctified Ordnance
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. Add 6" to the Range of ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit; Hazardous tests for that unit can be re-rolled.

enhancements.title: Inloaded Lethality
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST DOMINUS or TECH-PRIEST MANIPULUS model only. Add 3 to the Attacks and 1 to the Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons.

stratagems.title: Eradication Protocols
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade - Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, re-roll Wound rolls of 1; if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, also re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.title: Aggressive Impulse
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade - Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One SKORPIUS DUNERIDER model that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units that disembark after that model makes a Normal move remain eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.title: Targeting Override
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade - Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.title: Guided Retreat
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade - Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, it is eligible to shoot and charge after Falling Back. If it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, Desperate Escape tests for it can be re-rolled.

stratagems.title: Neural Overload
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade - Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Select one Override ability; until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active for your unit. Designer's Note: a unit that already has HALO OVERRIDE can have several Override abilities active at once, but suffers the mortal wounds. A unit without HALO OVERRIDE gains only the selected Override ability and does not benefit from other active Override abilities.

stratagems.title: Analytical Divination
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade - Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit, excluding KATAPHRON, within 8" and not within Engagement Range.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" instead if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit.

datasheets.title: Thulia Ghuld

weapons.name: Rod of the War Forge - strike
Rod of the War Forge - sweep

abilities.title: Rod of the War Forge
abilities.text: In your Command phase, select one Icon of War ability. Until your next Command phase, this model has that ability.

abilities.title: Mechanicus Bodyguard
abilities.text: While this model is within 3" of one or more other friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units, it has Lone Operative.

abilities.title: Cybernetic Augmentation
abilities.text: This model can move through terrain features, but cannot end a move within a wall, a floor, etc. It can be set up or end a move on any floor level of Ruins, but if that level is not the ground floor, it can only do so if its base does not overhang the floor at that level.

abilities.title: Secutor of Olympus
abilities.text: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy VEHICLE within 12" and roll one D6; on a 2+, it suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

abilities.title: Icon of War
abilities.text: Fanatical Devotion lets a friendly SKITARII or THULIA GHULD unit within 6" shoot and charge after Advancing. Adaptive Tactics lets it shoot and charge after Falling Back. The Fires of Mars makes both Imperatives active for it.

datasheets.composition: 1 Archmagos Terminus Thulia Ghuld - Epic Hero. Equipped with a Jericho-class conversion resonator and Rod of the War Forge. This model must be your Warlord.

datasheets.title: Hastarii Exterminators

abilities.title: Broad-spectrum Targeting Augurs
abilities.text: Each time a model in this unit attacks with an eradication caster against a unit excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units, that attack has Sustained Hits 1.

datasheets.composition: 1 Hastarii Exterminator Alpha and 4 Hastarii Exterminators. The Alpha is equipped with a Hastarii arc blaster, eradication caster and power weapon. Every other model is equipped with a Hastarii arc blaster, eradication caster and close-combat weapon. A Character that can attach to SKITARII RANGERS can attach to this unit instead.

datasheets.title: Hastarii Fusiliers

abilities.title: Monocular Targeting Helms
abilities.text: Each time a model in this unit attacks with a neutron fusil against a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has Ignores Cover.

datasheets.composition: 1 Hastarii Fusilier Alpha and 4 Hastarii Fusiliers. The Alpha is equipped with a neutron fusil, Hastarii phosphor blaster and power weapon. Every other model is equipped with a neutron fusil, Hastarii phosphor blaster and close-combat weapon. A Character that can attach to SKITARII RANGERS can attach to this unit instead.

datasheets.title: Servitor Battleclade

abilities.title: Network Override
abilities.text: While this unit contains one or more TECH-PRIEST models, it can perform an Action after Advancing and is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it started an Action.

datasheets.composition: 1 Servitor Underseer, 2 Gun Servitors and 6 Combat Servitors. The Underseer is equipped with a Mechanicus pistol and dataspikes. One Gun Servitor has a heavy arc rifle and servo-claw; the other has a heavy bolter and servo-claw. Every Combat Servitor has a phosphor blaster and servo-claw. A Character that can attach to KATAPHRON BREACHERS can attach to this unit instead.
datasheets.wargear: One Combat Servitor can replace its phosphor blaster with a meltagun. Up to three can replace their phosphor blasters with incendine igniters.

datasheets.title: X-101

abilities.title: Mindlock
abilities.text: While a TECH-PRIEST model is leading this model's unit, improve the Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill of this model's weapons by 1.

abilities.title: Bound Creation
abilities.text: While a TECH-PRIEST model is leading this model's unit, that TECH-PRIEST model has Feel No Pain 5+.

abilities.title: Servitor Bodyguard
abilities.text: At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, this model can join one other unit from your army that is being led by a TECH-PRIEST INFANTRY model. If it does, until the end of the battle, this model counts as being part of that Bodyguard unit, and that Bodyguard unit's Starting Strength is increased accordingly.

datasheets.composition: 1 X-101 - Epic Hero, equipped with grav-gun and hydraulic claw.

datasheets.title: Secutarii Hoplites

abilities.title: Titan Guard
abilities.text: You can target this unit with Heroic Intervention for 0CP even if another unit was targeted. If a friendly ADEPTUS TITANICUS unit is on the battlefield, you can re-roll the charge roll.

abilities.title: Enhanced data-tether
abilities.text: Each time you select the bearer's unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

abilities.title: Omnispex
abilities.text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit have the Ignores Cover ability.

datasheets.wargear: The Alpha's arc lance can be replaced with an archeotech pistol and can take an Alpha close combat weapon. One Hoplite can take an enhanced data-tether or omnispex.
datasheets.composition: 1 Hoplite Alpha and 4-9 Secutarii Hoplites. A Leader that can attach to SKITARII VANGUARD can attach to this unit instead.

datasheets.title: Secutarii Peltasts

abilities.title: Blind Barrage
abilities.text: After this unit has shot, select one enemy INFANTRY unit hit by those attacks. Until your next turn, it is blinded; while this unit remains on the battlefield, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for attacks made by models in that enemy unit.

abilities.title: Enhanced data-tether
abilities.text: Each time you select the bearer's unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

abilities.title: Omnispex
abilities.text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit have the Ignores Cover ability.

datasheets.wargear: The Alpha's galvanic caster can be replaced with an archeotech pistol and can take an Alpha close combat weapon. One Peltast can take an enhanced data-tether or omnispex.
datasheets.composition: 1 Peltast Alpha and 4-9 Secutarii Peltasts. A Leader that can attach to SKITARII VANGUARD can attach to this unit instead.

datasheets.title: Terrax-pattern Termite

abilities.title: Core
abilities.text: Deadly Demise D3, Deep Strike.

abilities.title: Termite Assault
abilities.text: This model must start the battle in Reserves, but neither it nor any units embarked within it count towards limits on the maximum number of Reserves units. It can be set up in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of mission rules. Embarked units can disembark after it is set up and must be more than 9" from all enemy models.

abilities.title: Damaged: 1-5 wounds remaining
abilities.text: Each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.title: Transport
abilities.text: Transport capacity 12 ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK or KATAPHRON models.

datasheets.wargear: The model's two combi-bolters can be replaced with two heavy flamers or two twin volkite chargers.
datasheets.composition: 1 Terrax-pattern Termite, equipped with Terrax melta cutter, two combi-bolters and Termite drill.

glossary.title: Heavy
glossary.summary: Weapon ability used by Protector Imperative.
glossary.full: A ranged weapon with Heavy receives the current Core Rules benefit when its unit Remains Stationary.

glossary.title: Assault
glossary.summary: Weapon ability used by Conqueror Imperative.
glossary.full: A unit with Assault weapons can remain eligible to shoot after Advancing, following the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Ignores Cover
glossary.summary: The target cannot receive the Benefit of Cover against this attack.
glossary.full: Resolve the ability using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Feel No Pain
glossary.summary: A wound-prevention roll made after a model would lose a wound.
glossary.full: Use the listed Feel No Pain value and the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Lethal Hits
glossary.summary: A Critical Hit automatically wounds the target.
glossary.full: Resolve Critical Hits using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Stealth
glossary.summary: A defensive Core ability used by several Mechanicus rules.
glossary.full: Resolve Stealth using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Devastating Wounds
glossary.summary: Critical Wounds use the Devastating Wounds sequence.
glossary.full: Resolve the ability using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Sustained Hits
glossary.summary: Critical Hits score the listed number of additional hits.
glossary.full: Resolve additional hits using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Anti-Vehicle
glossary.summary: Unmodified successful Wound rolls at the listed value score Critical Wounds against VEHICLE units.
glossary.full: Resolve Anti abilities using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Anti-Infantry
glossary.summary: Unmodified successful Wound rolls at the listed value score Critical Wounds against INFANTRY units.
glossary.full: Resolve Anti abilities using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Blast
glossary.summary: Blast weapons gain attacks against larger target units and cannot be fired into Engagement Range.
glossary.full: Resolve Blast using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Lance
glossary.summary: A charging model receives the current Lance wound modifier.
glossary.full: Resolve Lance using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Hazardous
glossary.summary: After attacking, take Hazardous tests for weapons with this ability.
glossary.full: Resolve Hazardous tests using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Infiltrators
glossary.summary: Deployment ability granted by Explorator Dispensation.
glossary.full: Resolve deployment using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Lone Operative
glossary.summary: Limits targeting of the unit outside the listed range.
glossary.full: Resolve Lone Operative using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Rapid Fire
glossary.summary: Adds the listed attacks while the target is within half range.
glossary.full: Resolve Rapid Fire using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Torrent
glossary.summary: Attacks with this weapon automatically hit.
glossary.full: Resolve Torrent using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Melta
glossary.summary: Adds the listed Damage while the target is within half range.
glossary.full: Resolve Melta using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Pistol
glossary.summary: Pistol weapons follow the current close-range shooting permissions.
glossary.full: Resolve Pistol using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Twin-linked
glossary.summary: Attacks made with this weapon can re-roll the Wound roll.
glossary.full: Resolve Twin-linked using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Doctrina Imperatives
glossary.summary: The Adeptus Mechanicus Army Rule with Protector and Conqueror modes.
glossary.full: Select and apply the active imperative according to the current publication.

glossary.title: Recon Augury
glossary.summary: Cohort Acquisitus keyword and Enhanced Augurs carrier.
glossary.full: A RECON AUGURY unit can analyse a visible enemy within 12 inches in its Shooting phase.

glossary.title: Halo Override
glossary.summary: Temporary keyword granted by Noospheric Transference.
glossary.full: HALO OVERRIDE units gain the selected Override ability and improve several Haloscreed Stratagems.

glossary.title: Data-Psalm
glossary.summary: Unique Detachment tag used by Luminen Auto-choir.
glossary.full: A DATA-PSALM Detachment cannot be taken with another DATA-PSALM Detachment.

glossary.title: Warhammer Legends
glossary.summary: Datasheets intended for the Warhammer Legends rules environment.
glossary.full: Check the current event pack and organiser guidance before using Legends datasheets in matched play.
